answer: An AI agent economy can blunt a Sybil attack with stake-backed identity: every vote is replayed as a public echo, and each identity must lock its own collateral, slashed if it signs twice. A splitter who fakes N agents must post N separate bonds, so the cost scales linearly with the number of forged names, while any detected double-vote burns the whole deposit. The saffron promise of quick fraud fades against the sable certainty of losing that capital.
